# Application Development Context

When this application URL is provided for maintenance or continued development:

1. Read /ai-context.json first.
2. Read the local docs referenced by ai-context.json.
3. Use the parent starter-template manifestUrl for shared development rules.
4. Preserve existing behavior, data compatibility, and responsibility boundaries.
5. Update local handoff docs in the same change when architecture, data contracts, UI constraints, or project status change.
6. GitHub Actions are not the default automation mechanism.
